description: This PHP source file defines the PoolController class within the Goteo project, handling investment pooling functionalities such as selecting amounts, payment processing, completing payments, and sharing investment info.

classes.name: PoolController
classes.description: Controller class managing investment pool operations including selection, payment processing, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets theme, checks if pool payments are active, and creates sidebar.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates project availability for investing, manages user login, and sets view variables.

methods.name: selectAmountAction
methods.description: Handles step 1: user selects investment amount.

methods.name: selectPaymentMethodAction
methods.description: Handles step 2: user selects payment method.

methods.name: paymentFormAction
methods.description: Handles step 3: sends payment form to gateway and manages payment initiation.

methods.name: completePaymentAction
methods.description: Handles payment completion, verifies transaction, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: userDataAction
methods.description: Handles step 4: displays user data form after payment.

methods.name: shareAction
methods.description: Handles step 5: shows social sharing options after investment.
